from.n: loom-commands tools > runCommandTool > returns `unknown_command` with the nearest listed names for a command the listing leaves out, sending nothing

to.n: loom-commands tools > runCommandTool > sends an unlisted command to the host for admission

from.n: loom-commands tools > runCommandTool > batches > returns one result per call in order, running the listed calls and sending nothing for an unknown one

to.n: loom-commands tools > runCommandTool > batches > returns one result per call in order, sending unlisted names to the host

from.n: loom-commands tools > prompt loop > runs a command at `enforce-explicit` only for a direct command, refusing one a `context` task asks for

to.n: loom-commands tools > prompt loop > admits declared reads from context tasks and gates other effects

from.n: loom-commands tools > prompt loop > judges a batch as one write: refused whole for a `context` task, and sent whole for a direct command

to.n: loom-commands tools > prompt loop > admits read batches from context tasks and gates mixed batches
